title: Tensor descent with the inverse representative normalization
statement: Let q:K→D and q′:H→E be functors, F:K→H and LF:D→E with a factor isomorphism eps:q⋙LF≅F⋙q′. Let P and S be representative subcategories with F carrying P into S. Assume precomposition by the product of P.ι⋙q is fully faithful. For tensor functors t,t′ on representatives and T,T′ on the target categories, let r,r′ be the representative tensor identifications and b the natural comparison F(t(X,Y))≅t′(F(X),F(Y)). There is a unique comparison a:T⋙LF≅(LF×LF)⋙T′ such that LF(r) followed by a, the two factor maps eps and the inverse r′ equals eps on the tensor followed by q′(b).

source.place: Coefficient presentation of the projection map; the explicit quotient augmentation is the one of Bhatt--Scholze, Definition 3.4.10 and Lemma 6.5.5, as retained in def-sf-projection-tensor-coefficient-comparison

proof.text: Apply tensorComparisonDescent to the natural isomorphism with components b and the factor isomorphism eps. Every component of eps and its tensor evaluation is invertible, supplying the descent hypotheses.

The descent equation becomes the required equation by postcomposition with the inverse target representative isomorphism. Conversely cancel that inverse to recover the descent equation. Transfer both existence and uniqueness along this equivalence.

theorem normalizedTensorDescent
    {K : Type u₁} [Category.{v₁} K] {H : Type u₂} [Category.{v₂} H]
    {D : Type u₃} [Category.{v₃} D] {E : Type u₄} [Category.{v₄} E]
    (q : K ⥤ D) (q' : H ⥤ E) (F : K ⥤ H) (LF : D ⥤ E)
    (eps : q ⋙ LF ≅ F ⋙ q')
    (P : ObjectProperty K) (S : ObjectProperty H)
    (hF : ∀ X, P X → S (F.obj X))
    (ff : ((Functor.whiskeringLeft (P.FullSubcategory × P.FullSubcategory) (D × D) E).obj
      ((P.ι ⋙ q).prod (P.ι ⋙ q))).FullyFaithful)
    (t : K × K ⥤ K) (t' : H × H ⥤ H)
    (T : D × D ⥤ D) (T' : E × E ⥤ E)
    (r : (P.ι.prod P.ι) ⋙ t ⋙ q ≅ ((P.ι ⋙ q).prod (P.ι ⋙ q)) ⋙ T)
    (r' : (S.ι.prod S.ι) ⋙ t' ⋙ q' ≅ ((S.ι ⋙ q').prod (S.ι ⋙ q')) ⋙ T')
    (b : ∀ Z : K × K, F.obj (t.obj Z) ≅ t'.obj ((F.prod F).obj Z))
    (hb : ∀ {X Y : K × K} (f : X ⟶ Y),
      F.map (t.map f) ≫ (b Y).hom = (b X).hom ≫ t'.map ((F.prod F).map f)) :
    ∃! a : T ⋙ LF ≅ (LF.prod LF) ⋙ T',
      ∀ X Y : P.FullSubcategory,
        LF.map (r.hom.app (X, Y)) ≫ a.hom.app (q.obj X.obj, q.obj Y.obj) ≫
            T'.map (Prod.mkHom (eps.hom.app X.obj) (eps.hom.app Y.obj)) ≫
            r'.inv.app (⟨F.obj X.obj, hF X.obj X.property⟩,
              ⟨F.obj Y.obj, hF Y.obj Y.property⟩) =
          eps.hom.app (t.obj (X.obj, Y.obj)) ≫ q'.map ((b (X.obj, Y.obj)).hom)
